what: Pressing the photo inside the gap (hole) at the character’s chest makes you dive through it. Text and buttons fade out in .8s, the whole artwork recedes to .9 in 1.1s, and .6s later the character swells 18.5x in 1.1s while the gap window grows in .4s to a scale covering the long side of the screen (inside the window 1.11x after .4s over .6s, the photo in the gap from 5x to 2.5x after .6s over 1.1s, all ease). After 1.8s it goes to that link’s address. Coming back with the back button restores the original state.

options.go: Time from press to moving on (ms), default 1800 — 0 means immediately
options.--fx-grow: Scale at which the figure swells (via style), default 18.5185 (20000/1080)
options.--fx-photo-from / --fx-photo-to: Photo scale inside the gap (at rest · after jumping in), default 5 · 2.5
options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Person (cutout with a gap) — swells around the center of the gap (transform-origin set to the gap)
options.[data-fx-part=hole]: Gap window — grows large enough to cover the screen (the part measures --fx-zoom)
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Text and buttons that drop out on dive-in (multiple)

use: CLICK TO DIVE
note: If fx:dive is preventDefault-ed, it does not navigate (for attaching to an app’s screen transitions). With reduced motion set, it navigates immediately

from.where: index.js·index.css .is-diving (CLICK TO DIVE · photo in the chest gap) — original .effect-recruit-slider.page-transition: .--content opacity .8s ease · .is-current .--image scale .9 1.1s ease · .--human scale(20000/1080) 1.1s ease .6s · .--bg scale var(--pt-zoom) .4s ease .6s · .--bg-inner 1.11 .6s ease .4s · img 2.5 1.1s ease .6s · navigates 1800ms after clickPageTransition
